policy.scope: Official entities/data providers referenced by Planetary Fate Lab public content.
policy.defaultRule: Use official public releases, preserve attribution, do not imply endorsement, and honor asset-specific restrictions. If rights or disclosure status is unclear, link rather than mirror and mark unresolved.
policy.securityRule: Never ingest classified, CUI, SSI, export-controlled/nonpublic technical data, leaked internal documents, or operational security details merely because they are accessible somewhere online.
policy.legalNote: Compliance-engineering baseline, not a legal opinion. Jurisdiction- and asset-specific terms control.

entities.name: National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA)
entities.usePolicy: NASA-created media generally may be used for educational/informational simulations with NASA acknowledged; third-party credits remain controlling. NASA identifiers have separate restrictions and no endorsement may be implied.
entities.securityPolicy: Use only officially public NASA information. NASA centers are federal installations; app maps only public visitor information and official releases.

entities.name: United States Space Force / Department of the Air Force
entities.usePolicy: Use only official Public Affairs releases and material clearly released for public use; do not imply endorsement.
entities.securityPolicy: Defense-installation photography/mapping can be legally and locally restricted. The app excludes protected/restricted facility detail, internal routing, security measures and live protection posture.

entities.name: Centre national d’études spatiales (CNES)
entities.usePolicy: Use official public visitor/mission information and asset-level credits/terms.
entities.securityPolicy: The Guiana Space Centre is a strategic restricted site; only public tour/viewing information is surfaced.

entities.name: European Space Agency (ESA)
entities.usePolicy: ESA website images/videos may be used for educational/editorial/informational purposes under ESA terms with required credit; commercial use generally requires separate authorization; ESA logo requires prior written authorization.
entities.securityPolicy: Only officially released mission/facility material is used; third-party copyrights remain controlling.

entities.name: Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA)
entities.usePolicy: JAXA permits specified press/scientific/educational/private uses under site policy with credits; business/commercial use and logo use require prior permission; third-party content requires separate rights.
entities.securityPolicy: Only official public visitor/mission information is used; TNSC keep-out rules are respected and not converted into internal navigation.

entities.name: Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) / Department of Space
entities.usePolicy: ISRO states its own site material may be reproduced free if accurate, non-derogatory, non-misleading and prominently sourced; third-party materials require separate authorization.
entities.securityPolicy: Only official public visitor/gallery and mission information is surfaced for SDSC SHAR; no internal navigation/security detail.

entities.name: Aerospace Committee of Kazakhstan / Government of Kazakhstan
entities.usePolicy: Use official government releases for Baikonur governance/tourism facts; link to current permit/visit channels rather than reproducing access-control details.
entities.securityPolicy: Baikonur tourism is permit-controlled; app excludes unauthorized-entry guidance and internal security/facility navigation.

entities.name: Roscosmos State Corporation
entities.usePolicy: No general asset-reuse license was verified in this audit. Use factual references and official links; do not mirror Roscosmos media unless asset-specific rights are established.
entities.securityPolicy: For Baikonur and other strategic facilities, show only information independently released by competent public authorities; no internal navigation or nonpublic technical detail.

entities.name: National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA)
entities.usePolicy: NOAA-created media is generally public domain; credit NOAA, preserve third-party restrictions, do not imply endorsement, and do not use NOAA seals/logos without permission.
entities.securityPolicy: Operational feeds are displayed as time-stamped public data, not as guarantees or official warnings.

entities.name: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS)
entities.usePolicy: USGS-authored data/information is generally U.S. public domain; credit requested. Third-party material and official identifiers/logos can have separate restrictions.
entities.securityPolicy: Use public science/cartographic products only.

entities.name: Esri / ArcGIS
entities.usePolicy: Applications using ArcGIS content/services must display required Esri and data-provider attribution and follow service terms. Do not strip provider credits or assume unrestricted tile caching.
entities.securityPolicy: Geospatial services are not used to add prohibited restricted-facility detail beyond the app disclosure policy.

entities.name: Cesium
entities.usePolicy: CesiumJS is open-source under Apache 2.0; Cesium ion and third-party hosted content have separate terms and attribution requirements.
entities.securityPolicy: Geospatial capability is constrained by facility disclosure policy; no restricted-site internal-navigation layer is generated.

entities.name: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL)
entities.kind: NASA federally funded research and development center managed by Caltech
entities.usePolicy: Use NASA/JPL official mission/data releases with exact credit lines where given; asset-specific third-party credits remain controlling.
entities.securityPolicy: Only public mission/science data are used.

entities.name: International Cospas-Sarsat Programme
entities.usePolicy: Use official public educational/system information with attribution.
entities.securityPolicy: The simulation does not expose private distress-beacon identity/location records or operational responder data.

entities.name: Canadian Space Agency (CSA)
entities.usePolicy: Use CSA materials only under applicable CSA/Government of Canada terms; educational/informational reuse requires source credit/no implied endorsement and commercial redistribution generally requires permission.
entities.securityPolicy: Use only officially released public mission and educational material.

entities.name: Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU/APL)
entities.kind: U.S. university affiliated research laboratory / mission partner
entities.usePolicy: Use NASA mission pages for facts by default. APL images/video are not mirrored unless permission or an applicable license is confirmed.
entities.securityPolicy: Do not ingest proprietary, controlled, classified, export-restricted, facility-security, or nonpublic program information.

entities.name: Southwest Research Institute (SwRI)
entities.kind: independent research and development organization / mission partner
entities.usePolicy: Use NASA mission pages for facts by default. SwRI site/media materials are copyrighted and not mirrored for commercial/public distribution without applicable permission.
entities.securityPolicy: Only public mission/science information is used; proprietary or nonpublic SwRI material is excluded.

entities.name: Google
entities.usePolicy: Google account sign-in is used only under current Google OAuth/service terms; Google Maps imagery is not copied into the app and no endorsement is implied.
entities.securityPolicy: Identity integration requests only minimum profile/identity scopes; Gmail mailbox access is not requested for login.

entities.name: GitHub
entities.usePolicy: Use GitHub under current platform/developer terms; protect trademarks and do not imply sponsorship. User-login permissions are minimized and repository access is not requested.
entities.securityPolicy: Repository/deployment credentials remain operator secrets and are never embedded in the public client.

entities.name: Microsoft
entities.usePolicy: Microsoft identity is used under current Microsoft identity-platform terms and delegated-permission model.
entities.securityPolicy: Ordinary login requests basic identity/profile access only; mail, calendar, files, directory-wide, or admin-restricted permissions are not requested.

entities.name: Natural Earth / NACIS
entities.usePolicy: Natural Earth raster/vector data are public domain; provenance is retained even though attribution is not required by its terms.
entities.securityPolicy: Used only as low-detail fallback cartography and not to derive restricted-facility internal details.

entities.name: Blockade Labs / Skybox AI
entities.usePolicy: API/service/generated-asset use is governed by current Blockade Labs terms and applicable package terms; no secret API key is embedded in clients.
entities.securityPolicy: The service is not used to generate or infer security-sensitive facility layouts or restricted operational details.

entities.name: U.S. Department of Commerce — Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS)
entities.usePolicy: EAR references are used as compliance context only, not as a license determination.
entities.securityPolicy: Public availability does not automatically establish unrestricted status under every regime; nonpublic/export-controlled technical data are excluded.

entities.name: U.S. House Office of the Law Revision Counsel / United States Code
entities.usePolicy: Statutory text is cited as authoritative source material; Planetary Fate Lab does not provide a legal opinion.
entities.securityPolicy: 18 U.S.C. §§ 795 and 797 are used as conservative constraints for protected defense-installation imagery/mapping and publication.

entities.name: Third-party scholarly publishers and journals
entities.usePolicy: Planetary Fate Lab links/cites bibliographic sources and does not mirror full articles, figures, or paywalled media unless separately licensed.
entities.securityPolicy: Published scholarship does not override facility, export-control, privacy, classified/CUI, or other disclosure restrictions.

entities.name: Planetary Fate Lab internal models/content
entities.usePolicy: Original application content; external-source claims must be separately sourced.
entities.securityPolicy: Internal simulations must not introduce restricted, nonpublic, personal, or operational-security data.
